final: SELECT AVG(player_avg) AS avg_player_avg, AVG(player_avg - overall_avg) AS avg_difference FROM (SELECT player_avg, overall_avg FROM (SELECT player_id, AVG(1.0 * a / g) AS player_avg FROM fielding_postseason WHERE a IS NOT NULL AND g IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id) AS players CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(player_avg) AS overall_avg FROM (SELECT AVG(1.0 * a / g) AS player_avg FROM fielding_postseason WHERE a IS NOT NULL AND g IS NOT NULL GROUP BY player_id)) AS overall WHERE player_avg > overall_avg AND overall_avg IS NOT NULL)
